name: Localization Analyzer
tagline: Find missing and unused localization keys
description: Localization Analyzer scans Flutter ARB and localization usage to surface missing keys, unused entries, and consistency issues across locales before they reach production.

showcase.problem: Localization drift—missing keys, unused entries, and locale inconsistencies—often appears only after QA or production releases.
showcase.solution: A desktop analyzer that scans ARB files and Dart usage to report gaps early in the development loop.

features.title: Missing key detection
features.description: Compare usage against ARB definitions across locales.

features.title: Unused entry reports
features.description: Find keys that no longer appear in code.

demo.note: CLI/desktop demo packaging is not published yet.

showcase.installation: Install via the upcoming desktop package or run from source with Flutter on macOS, Linux, or Windows.
showcase.contributing: Report false positives and locale edge cases via GitHub issues.
